reviews.title: New AI features
reviews.text: These are fun but depending on photo selection youget few actual look alikes particularly with the children’s faces - bit cartoony. I think very careful selection with practice would improve it. However it is really useful but at the moment it’s too expensive - I would consider an annual subscription or say 50 goes for a cheaper price or something.

reviews.title: Do not purchase!
reviews.text: Do not waste your $ on this app. I had used it years ago and was pleased. Purchased it again a few days ago to make a Christmas gift and was disappointed. After taking a bunch of photos, I looked at the results, poor resolution and reflections on the photos. Packed photos up and stopped using this app, it was a complete waste of my time. Called Apple for refund, was told to allow 24-48 hours for full refund. Got notification through email today that the refund has been denied by the company. This app isn’t cheap, I’m out over $63 and got nothing out of it. I’m going to use a scanner on my computer to make copies of photographs to keep the clarity, so I don’t lose resolution when I enlarge and print the photos. I’m so upset, I don’t have $ to waste like this. I wish I had read the reviews, prior to my purchase, instead of going by my past experience with this app. Reviews found for this app —> Image quality: The quality is not as high as a traditional scanner, and the resulting images may have less clarity and detail, especially when enlarged. *Also located this information: PhotoScan by Google is free and is the best app I've found. It takes 4 pictures of the photo and combines them to eliminated distortion and glare.*
